tools.description: Read games in GameTrack, wishlist included, by title unless orderBy says otherwise. Use states ["WANTED"] for the wishlist. Filters intersect; empty arrays match nothing. Cursor is the next page offset; keep the criteria and limit unchanged across pages.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

addedBefore.description: Added to GameTrack before this timestamp or day.

addedFrom.description: Added to GameTrack at or after this timestamp or day.

excludeTags.description: Leave out games with any of these tag titles, ignoring case; [] leaves out nothing.

finishedBefore.description: Finished before this timestamp or day.

finishedFrom.description: Finished at or after this timestamp or day.

genres.description: Match games with any of these genres, by name with or without its emoji, ignoring case; [] matches nothing.

platforms.description: Match games owned on any of these platforms, ignoring case; [] matches nothing.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the title, developer, or publisher.

rated.description: true for games the user has rated, false for unrated ones.

releasedBefore.description: Released before this timestamp or day.

releasedFrom.description: Released at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp, or YYYY-MM-DD for that day's start in the host time zone.

states.description: Match any of these states; [] matches nothing.

tags.description: Match games with any of these tag titles, ignoring case; [] matches nothing.

limit.description: Maximum items in the page, from 1 through 100; defaults to 50.

direction.description: ASC for smallest or earliest first, DESC for the reverse; defaults to ASC.

field.description: What to sort by. Games without the value sort last.

tools.name: games_search

addedDate.description: When the game was added to GameTrack.

additionalPlatforms.description: Other platforms the user also has the game on.

additionalPlaytime.description: Additional play time in hours, as stored.

completion.description: Progress through the game, as a percentage from 0 through 100.

completionState.description: How far a completed game was taken, as stored: 0 when not completed, otherwise 1 through 3.

criticRating.description: The critics' score out of 100; 0 or -1 when there is none.

finishDate.description: When the user finished or abandoned the game.

format.description: The format owned, as stored; 0 for most games.

gameState.description: The state as stored: 1 in progress, 2 queued, 3 collection, 4 completed, 5 abandoned, 6 wanted.

genres.description: The game's genres, ordered by genre ID.

name.description: The name, with the emoji GameTrack shows before it.

id.description: The game's UUID in GameTrack, in uppercase; it does not change over time.

igdbId.description: The game's ID at IGDB, where GameTrack takes its metadata from.

ownedPlatform.description: The platform the user has the game on.

platforms.description: Every platform the game is released on.

playStationId.description: ID of the linked PlayStation game.

completionState.description: How far the playthrough was taken, as a game's completionState.

lastPlayedAt.description: When the game was last played in this playthrough.

name.description: The name the user gave the playthrough.

progress.description: Progress as a percentage from 0 through 100; -1 when not set.

rating.description: The user's rating of this playthrough; 0 when unrated.

state.description: The playthrough's state as stored, with the meanings of a game's gameState; 0 for a game on the wishlist.

tags.description: Tags on the playthrough, as stored.

priority.description: The priority as stored; -1 on every game seen so far.

releaseDate.description: When the game is released. 4001-01-01 means the date is to be announced, and a date at the last second of a year in Pacific time means only the year is known.

releaseYear.description: The release year as stored: 0 for most games, which have only a release date, and 3000 when the date is to be announced.

reviewSpoilers.description: Whether the review is marked as containing spoilers.

siteUrl.description: URL of the game's web page.

startDate.description: When the user started the game.

state.description: Where the game stands: IN_PROGRESS, QUEUED, COLLECTION, COMPLETED, ABANDONED, or WANTED for the wishlist. Derived from gameState; absent for a value the server does not know.

status.description: An older status label, kept as stored; GameTrack no longer updates it and it often disagrees with state.

steamDeckStatus.description: Steam Deck compatibility as stored: -1 when not checked, otherwise 0 through 3.

steamId.description: ID of the linked Steam game.

tags.description: Titles of the tags on the game, in alphabetical order.

timeToBeatComplete.description: Hours to complete everything; 0 when unknown.

timeToBeatExtras.description: Hours to finish the story and extras; 0 when unknown.

timeToBeatStory.description: Hours to finish the main story; 0 when unknown.

timeToBeatType.description: The time-to-beat type as stored: 0 through 2.

updatedAt.description: When the game's entry last changed.

userRating.description: The user's rating from 1 through 10; 0 when unrated.

userRatingValue.description: The user's rating as GameTrack exports it: the fractional rating when one is set, otherwise userRating.

xboxId.description: ID of the linked Xbox game.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; omitted on the last page.

totalCount.description: Number of games matching the filter.

tools.description: Read every list, by name, with its rules. A smart list has rules and no stored games: GameTrack computes them. games_search can reproduce status, tag, and release date rules with states, tags, excludeTags, and releasedBefore.
tools.name: lists_list

calendar.description: Whether the list is shown in the calendar.

games.description: The games of a manual list in position order. Omitted for a smart list: GameTrack computes those from the rules and stores none.

position.description: The game's index in the list.

section.description: The section of the list the game is in.

groupType.description: What the list groups by, as stored.

id.description: The list's UUID in GameTrack, in uppercase.

listId.description: The list's numeric ID in GameTrack.

position.description: The list's place among the lists.

smart.description: Whether the list is a smart list, whose games GameTrack computes from smartFilters.

smartFilterMatching.description: How a smart list combines its rules, as stored.

smartFilters.description: The rules of a smart list; empty for a manual list.

filterOption.description: How the rule applies, such as exclude or before.

selectedFromDate.description: The start of the rule's date range.

selectedOptions.description: The values the rule matches, such as status or tag names.

selectedProgress.description: The progress the rule compares with.

selectedRating.description: The rating the rule compares with.

selectedToDate.description: The end of the rule's date range.

type.description: What the rule tests, such as status, tags, or releaseDate.

sortType.description: What the list sorts by, as stored.

tintColour.description: The list's colour as stored: a base64 archive of a UIColor.
